dashboard.description: Collects CPU frequency state from /sys/devices/system/cpu (per-core current/min/max frequency, governor) and hardware thermal-throttle counters (package_throttle_count,

search.query: index=main sourcetype="throttle:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="throttle.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="throttle:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
